;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Netherlands]] halts funding of the [[Syrian opposition]] and police forces, saying the chances of them winning the war are "extremely limited". Dutch support for the [[White Helmets (Syrian Civil War)|White Helmets]] will also end in December 2018. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2018/09/the-netherlands-stops-supporting-syrian-rebels-ahead-of-idlib-offensive/ (Dutch News)]
*[[Somali Civil War]]
**A car bomb in [[Mogadishu]] kills six people and injures 16 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/09/somalia-suicide-blast-targets-government-offices-mogadishu-180910075317444.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]], [[2018 Tripoli attack]]
**Gunmen storm the headquarters of the [[National Oil Corporation]] (NOC) in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], [[Libya]]. At least four people are killed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-45470943 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi earthquake]]
**The death toll from the [[earthquake]] in [[Hokkaido]], [[Japan]] rises to 44. There are now no reports of individuals missing and the search operations have been called off. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-09/10/c_137458629.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Florence]] regains strength to a [[Saffir–Simpson scale#Category 4|category 4]] major hurricane and is expected to threaten the [[East Coast of the United States]] near [[The Carolinas|the Carolinas]] in the coming days, with the potential for a category 4 or 5 landfall with very large rainfall totals. Preparations are underway for evacuation of around 1 million coastal inhabitants of South Carolina. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2018/09/10/Florence-regains-hurricane-strength-on-track-to-hit-US-East-Coast/2931536167291/ (Upi)] [https://www.postandcourier.com/news/evacuations-ordered-for-sc-coast-as-hurricane-florence-nears-effective/article_ecae59d2-b507-11e8-b430-c30c881683a8.html (''Post and Courier'')]
*A gas depot explodes in [[Lafia]], [[Nigeria]], killing at least 35 people and leaving some burned beyond recognition. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/nigerian-gas-tanker-explosion-kills-at-least-35-1.4818038 (CBC)]

;International relations
*[[Palestine–United States relations]]
**''[[The Wall Street Journal]]'' reports that [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Advisor]] [[John R. Bolton]] is expected to announce today the closure of the [[Palestine Liberation Organization]] office in [[Washington, D.C.|Washington]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-09-10/trump-to-close-palestine-liberation-organization-s-u-s-office (Bloomberg)]
**[[Palestinians|Palestinian]] diplomat [[Saeb Erekat]] says that the [[United States]] "is willing to disband the international system in order to protect [[Israel]]i crimes". [https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinians-seethe-over-planned-us-closure-of-washington-office/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[North Korea–Russia relations]]
**[[Government of Russia|Kremlin]] aide [[Yuri Ushakov]] says that [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] has sent a letter to meet [[North Korea]] leader [[Kim Jong-un]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-north-korea-kim-letter/kremlin-says-putin-sent-an-invitation-to-north-korean-leader-idUSKCN1LQ134 (Reuters)]
*''[[Nieuwsuur]]'' reports the [[Netherlands|Dutch]] government has provided funding over the past two years to [[Syria]]n rebel group [[Jabhat Al-Shamiyah|Jabhat al-Shamiya]], despite Dutch prosecutors describing the group as a "salafist and jihadistic" terror group and preparing to bring a man to trial next week accused of being a member. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2018/09/dutch-funded-jihadist-group-in-syria-terror-trial-may-now-falter/ (Dutch News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Attorney General of California|California Attorney General]] [[Xavier Becerra]] announces the arrest of 32 [[East Bay (San Francisco Bay Area)|East Bay]] [[List of California street gangs|street gangs]]ters linked to a million-dollar fraud conspiracy. [https://www.sfgate.com/crime/article/32-East-Bay-street-gang-members-arrested-in-13218991.php (SFGate.com)]
*[[Death of Marrisa Shen]]
**Ibrahim Ali, a 28-year old [[Refugees of the Syrian Civil War|Syrian refugee]] living in [[Canada]], is charged with first-degree murder in the [[Death of Marrisa Shen|death of Marrisa Shen]]. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/09/13/syrian-refugee-charged-in-random-murder-girl-13-in-canada.html (Fox News)] [https://nypost.com/2018/09/10/syrian-refugee-arrested-for-murder-of-canadian-teen/ (''New York Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Swedish general election, 2018|Swedish general election]]
**The center-left parties that form the current government obtain 40.6% of the vote, the center-right alliance winning 40.3%. The far-right [[Sweden Democrats]] gain 17.6%. A long process to form a coalition government now seems likely. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/09/10/europe/sweden-elections-results-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Moscow mayoral election, 2018]]
**The [[President of Russia|Russian presidential office]] confirms that [[mayor of Moscow]] [[Sergey Sobyanin|Sergei Sobyanin]] is reelected for a second and final term. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/putin-congratulates-incumbent-moscow-mayor-so-428830.html (Sputnik via Urdupoint)]
*[[Impeachment of Park Geun-hye]]
**[[Conservatism in South Korea|Conservative]] [[South Korea|South Korean]] protesters at the [[Seoul station]] call for the release of imprisoned former [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Park Geun-hye]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/09/10/South-Korea-protesters-demand-Park-Geun-hyes-release/5671536565760/ (Upi)]  
*[[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Advisor]] [[John R. Bolton]] threatens the [[International Criminal Court]] with sanctions should the organisation try to prosecute Americans for [[war crimes]] committed in [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-icc/trump-administration-to-take-tough-stance-against-international-criminal-court-idUSKCN1LQ076 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[SpaceX]] successfully launches [[Canada|Canadian]] communication satellite [[Telstar 18V]] from [[Cape Canaveral Air Force Station]].  It was deployed into [[geostationary transfer orbit]] (GTO) approximately 32 minutes after rocket's liftoff. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/spacex-falcon-9-rocket-launches-canadian-comsat/ (CBS News)]
